system.description:
Choose one weapon type you are trained in.

  • Once per round, reroll one missed attack roll with it, and gain +2 to Damage with it.
  • You can take this feat again for a different weapon each time, never a weapon in the group a Fighter has specialised in.
  • It can also be learned in downtime as a Trained Feat, with no check at the end (Book I).

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

rules.value: Weapon Master: once per round, reroll one missed attack with this weapon.
